## Overview

Dune: Imperium – Uprising is a deck-building worker placement game set in the Dune universe. Each player is a Leader representing one of the Great Houses of the Landsraad (or another powerful figure). You play cards to send Agents to board spaces, acquire new cards for your deck, deploy units (troops and sandworms) to the Conflict, and grow Influence with the four Factions (Emperor, Spacing Guild, Bene Gesserit, Fremen). At the end of a round, if any player has reached **10 or more Victory Points** (or the Conflict Deck is empty), the game ends and whoever has the most VP wins.

Compared with base Dune: Imperium, the rulebook's difference notes call out: Spies and observation posts, a new **Spy** Agent icon, additional board spaces requiring 2 Influence with a Faction, sandworms and Maker Hooks, Battle Icons and Sandworm Reward Doubling, Objective cards (which determine the first player), and the new optional CHOAM Module. There is **no Mentat** Agent and there are **no Foldspace** cards. Cards of any type can override the usual rules of the game.

**Scope:** Original English 2023 Uprising, rulebook version 23-10-12: complete standard 2–4-player play, including the required two-player Rival rules below, plus the optional standard base-box CHOAM Module. Solo-only rules, all optional Rival variants (including Streamlined Rivals), six-player teams and cross-game expansions are excluded. In two-player play use an ordinary scoring Rival, rather than the two Streamlined-only Rivals Lady Amber Metulli and Glossu “The Beast” Rabban. The 10 contrasting-back Rise of Ix contracts are identified for sorting only and are not used in this scope. Board-space rules come from the publisher’s Uprising Board Space Guide; the labeled FAQ section uses relevant clarifications from the official January 13, 2025 FAQ.
